subject: Incentive request: incremental credits for competitive evaluation
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@evalops.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: incremental credits to run evaluation against competitor

Hi Rishi,

We're running a two-week bake-off between Redwood and two other providers (internal name: Project Orion). To get statistically meaningful metrics and to run adversarial prompt sets we need approximately 200k generation tokens and a 14-day trial extension.

Current trial capped at 20k tokens; would Redwood be able to provide additional credits or a short promotional allowance to support this RFP? If approved, this is likely to move us toward a paid pilot — expected 6-9 month POC with potential ARR ~$250k.

Attached: RFP_Bakeoff_Scope.pdf (summary of test cases and timeline).

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Evaluations
EvalOps Inc.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@evalops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: incremental credits to run evaluation against competitor

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the scope doc. I can escalate for promotional credits and a trial extension. Two quick Qs to help internal approval:

- Confirm that the 200k is generation tokens (not combined gen+embedding)?
- Timeline: you mentioned two weeks — when do you plan to start? Are there hard dates?

Internal note: cc'ing Laura and Aditya for approval/finance tracking. My ask will be for a bakeoff allowance + a short canary promo code to differentiate this from standard trial.

Attachments: proposed-map.docx (draft MAP we can send if approved).

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: incremental credits to run evaluation against competitor

Thanks for the context. High level:

- Strategic fit: EvalOps has a strong footprint in retail analytics (matches our target vertical).
- Opportunity: If they move to pilot, expected ARR is material (~$250k as Rishi noted).

I can approve up to 75k tokens + a 7-day extension from a manager budget. Anything beyond that needs Steph's authorization (exec discretionary). Please prep a short one-pager with competitor names and the proposed promo code. Looping Steph for exec sign-off.

Laura
Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Request: incremental credits to run evaluation against competitor — exec approval request

Hi Steph,

Forwarding request from EvalOps. Summary:
- They requested 200k generation tokens + 14-day trial extension to run our model vs two competitors (Project Orion RFP).
- Potential ARR ~250k; timeline starts 10/25 (they want to run next week).
- Manager-approved up to 75k + 7 days.

Attachments: RFP_Bakeoff_Scope.pdf, pricing-sheet.xlsx

Ask: Can you approve up to 150k tokens and a 14-day extension? If yes, we'll issue a promo code (suggest: BAKEOFF-2026) and require a brief MOU. Finance (Aditya) will record the credit allowance.

Appreciate a quick reply — they're scheduling the comparison next week.

Thanks,
Rishi
